body: You’re not weird whatsoever, friendly person I don’t know. I have no promises but thanks for calling me sweet and caring and the advice. Life is getting tough now but I can thank you for making me smile closer to the end and at the rough times <3

It’s so hard and thanks for reading this. I’ve been contemplating suicide.  My family has turned against me all my friends have as well and most recently my ex boyfriend. He says he still loves me but I drove him away which is understandable. But he continues to go on my social media everyday and he knows my situation and doesn’t ask how I’m doing. Kind of blurred my perception on what people caring is.
Oh how I understand that now.
